headline: 14 contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Solana, and Plume Mainnet; includes USCC token proxy, AllowlistV3 proxy, Chainlink oracle, and SVM token program addresses sourced from official Superstate docs.

findings.text: Etherscan search confirmed USCC Token Proxy at 0x14d60E7FDC0D71d8611742720E4C50E7a974020c with EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy pattern; implementation at 0x9b7282cb80baa4b1f8f6436f8d531b436bae2a70 (SuperstateTokenV5_1). No direct block-explorer name-tag search was attempted for Plume Mainnet or Solana (no canonical EVM explorer for Solana; Plume explorer URL not in allow-list).

Official deployed contracts page at https://docs.superstate.com/investors/smart-contracts lists 7 Ethereum Mainnet addresses, 3 Plume Mainnet addresses, and 6 Solana Mainnet addresses with named roles. Set as deployed_contracts_doc.

Audit links listed in docs: ChainSecurity (compound-suptb), and 0xMacro audits superstate-1 through superstate-11. No audit PDFs were fetched directly in this run; addresses in-scope were not independently extracted from audit PDFs.

GitHub repos identified: https://github.com/superstateinc/ustb and https://github.com/superstateinc/onchain-redemptions. No commit SHA pinned as repos were not directly fetched in this run; no deployment artifacts walked.

Ethereum: 7 addresses surfaced. Plume Mainnet: 3 addresses surfaced (AllowlistV3, USTB Token, USCC Token proxies). Solana: 6 program/token addresses surfaced. All three chains in protocol.chains covered.
No factory contracts identified in the address lists. USCC and USTB tokens are ERC-20 proxies, not factories. No factory-child enumeration needed.

Role taxonomy applied: USCC Token Proxy and USTB Token Proxy classified as token; AllowlistV3 Proxy as admin; RedemptionIdle Proxy as vault; oracles as oracle; Solana Allowlist program as admin; Solana USCC Token 2022 as token; Burn Address as other. actor_class set to unknown for all because on-chain bytecode read was blocked in this run.

All 14 addresses in admin_addresses trace to the fetched docs page https://docs.superstate.com/investors/smart-contracts. Implementation contract addresses surfaced via Etherscan search snippets but not directly fetched as full pages; they are recorded in unknowns with D8 code.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice: official Superstate docs page and Etherscan search results yielded 14 named contract addresses across Ethereum, Solana, and Plume Mainnet. DeFiPunkd on-chain reads were blocked (URLs not in prior messages). All addresses trace to the fetched docs URL. Implementation addresses seen in Etherscan snippets are noted in unknowns for next-run verification.

evidence.shows: Superstate website live; confirms Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund (USCC) product exists on Ethereum, Solana, and Plume under Superstate's FundOS infrastructure

protocol_metadata.about: Bitwise USCC (formerly Superstate Crypto Carry Fund) is a tokenized investment fund that offers Qualified Purchasers exposure to crypto basis strategies — capturing the premium between spot and futures prices on BTC and ETH — combined with U.S. Treasury securities for yield diversification. Investors hold fund shares as permissioned ERC-20 tokens (USCC) on Ethereum, Plume Mainnet, or as SPL Token 2022 on Solana, all gated by a KYC allowlist controlled by Superstate. Bitwise Asset Management assumed investment management on June 1, 2026, while Superstate continues operating the onchain infrastructure including token issuance, transfer agency, and smart contracts. Subscriptions and redemptions are processed in USD or USDC each market day.
